title: Axis deer damage and control programs
summary: Maui ranchers say deer are hurting agriculture on the island. A ranching group leader said ranchers have cut their herds by more than 50 percent because deer compete with cattle for grass. Local calves are now kept and processed on Maui to feed residents.
